anomalies.observed: The LDO output REG2 pin 1 is connected to the +3.3V net, but the separate +3V3 net has no regulator source and the MCU VDD pins are listed in unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V LDO rail should feed both MCUs and sensors; +3V3 and +3.3V should be connected or be the same net, and FCC1/NAVC1 VDD pins should be on that rail.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V LDO (MCUs + sensors) | Hades (top sheet) | ST LD39200PU33R
3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The microcontrollers are not powered from the LDO output, so the board cannot execute its intended navigation or flight-control functions.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 HSE crystal HSE1 is connected to FCC1 pins 5 and 37 (PE6/PE7), not to the oscillator pins PH0/PH1; FCC1 PH1 is instead on VREF+_FCC. NAVC1 HSE crystal HSE2 is not connected to NAVC1 oscillator pins at all.
anomalies.expected: Both 25 MHz HSE crystals should connect to the MCU OSC_IN/OSC_OUT pins PH0/PH1, per the HSE crystal design and standard STM32 practice.

evidence.quote: HSE crystal (both MCUs) | FCC / NAVC | ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3

anomalies.impact: The external high-speed clock cannot operate on the correct oscillator pins; the MCUs would fall back to internal clocks or fail to meet timing requirements.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 VCAP pins are connected to signal nets: FCC1 pin 48 (VCAP) drives U11 input, and FCC1 pin 73 (VCAP) is connected to UART3_RX_FCC at the UART3 connector. No VCAP decoupling capacitors are present on these pins.
anomalies.expected: STM32H753 VCAP power pins must be connected to decoupling capacitors to ground and must not be tied to UART or buffer signal nets; UART3 should connect to MCU UART pins.
anomalies.impact: The MCU core regulator decoupling is missing and VCAP is loaded by external signals, likely causing unstable core supply behavior and a nonfunctional UART3 interface.
